description: Extracts every player-facing string, gets it translated, and puts it back with layout overflow, font coverage and plural rules checked. Handles the text pipeline, not the writing of it.
when_to_use: the game has to run in another language
strings are hardcoded and need extracting
translated text is overflowing or missing glyphs
avoid_when: the request is to write the original text
the work is a locale-specific gameplay change
